notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Combat Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added new turret defense system that actively shoots down enemies
[*] Enhanced enemy destruction mechanics - enemies now require successful hits instead of self-destructing on word completion
[/list]

[h1]Interface Updates[/h1]

[list]
[*] Implemented comprehensive settings menu for customizable gameplay experience
[*] Added crosshair indicator to show currently targeted enemy
[*] Fixed word highlighting issues when switching between multiple enemies
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[b]Resolved enemy targeting bug where:[/b]

[list]
[*] Word highlights persisted after switching targets
[*] Same enemy could be re-targeted unnecessarily
[/list]
